item.title: Dynamic delays Thailand AI mass production, clouding 2026 revenue target
item.summary: Dynamic said its Thailand plant will not begin mass-producing high-end AI products until the fourth quarter of 2026, a delay that could make it harder for the PCB maker to achieve its goal of deriving 20% of sales from AI that year. For global readers, the timeline underscores how supply-chain bottlenecks can ripple through AI hardware markets.
